resources.string: Put pictures in this folder on the TV with sync.sh or sync.ps1:
Show the time briefly with each picture
Show when a picture was taken (month and year)
Three prints instead of full screen (no clips)
Sky that follows the time of day behind the prints
Show the weather (needs a town or the TV\'s location)
Uses the town typed below, or else the TV\'s rough location, and Open-Meteo. Off: nothing goes over the network.
Town, with the country if the name is common
Town for the weather (empty: the TV\'s own location)
No town called %1$s was found. Try its name with the country.
Open-Meteo could not be reached to look the town up. Check the connection and press Done again.
Allow location access for the weather.
Location services are off on this TV: turn them on for the weather.
Location is on. The weather is updated every 30 minutes.
